references.text: Previous verse introducing the right of redemption and the role of a kinsman-redeemer (goel)
Parallel law on the right of redemption for an Israelite who has sold himself as a slave, where relatives may redeem him
Boaz explains the right of redemption in practice, where the nearest relative has the first right to redeem Elimelech's field
Boaz as goel (kinsman-redeemer) and the principle that the nearest relative has the first right to redeem
Jeremiah exercises his right of redemption as the nearest relative to buy a field in Anathoth
The continuation explaining how the redemption price is calculated and what happens if one cannot redeem the land
